name: Dolly
source:
There is more to this gal than just her incredibly well-formed dustiness - Dolly is a studied professor! She wont make any talkback, and specially no talking down to, so treat her with the respect that this teacher and her pet deserve.
Likes: Research, Modeling, Lint Eastwood
Dislikes: Patronizing talk, Sneezing
